items.label: 【POWERFUL &CONVENIENT】
items.value: Say goodbye to traditional cleaning tools, let the new household cleaning tools change your life. We collected the needs of users from all over the Internet, combined with the advice of top designers, to produce an ergonomic electric spin scrubber. The electric spin scrubber uses top-of-the-line chip technology. Battery capacity up to 3000MAH. The battery takes 2-3 hours to fully charge and will work for up to 90 minutes on a full charge

items.label: 【3 ADJUSTABLE SIZES & CORDLESS】
items.value: We've updated the brush with 3 adjustable designs and 3 lengths: 12in, 43in and 54in. You can adjust the length by easily rotating the handle and pulling it out. You can also remove and install the handle and extension rod. You can easily clean every corner of the house without having to bend over or kneel down. Use Bpmves household essentials, caring for the waist and joints, friendly to the elderly and people with waist problems, save time and effort

items.label: 【PROTECTION DESIGN】
items.value: Electric spin scrubber adopts a tight protection design. It can be used in a humid environment or washed by dipping the brush head in water. You can easily clean shower bathrooms, bathtubs, stone tile floors, grout, and grooves. Cordless design allows you to get rid of rope restrictions, further improving cleaning speed and achieving efficient deep cleaning. Note: Do not immerse the entire handle in water

items.label: 【DUAL SPEED & EFFICIENT】
items.value: The internal motor system of the electric spin scrubber has 2 speeds: low speed -300RPM and high speed -500RPM. The default speed is low when the brush is started, and long press for 2 seconds to easily switch to high speed. The dual speed design allows you to choose the cleaning method that works for you, eliminating the traditional manual cleaning and saving you valuable time

items.label: 【8 REPLACEMENT BRUSH HEADS】
items.value: Our electric spin scrubber comes with a wealth of accessories: 8 replaceable brush heads as well as chargers and hooks. The eight replaceable brush heads are suitable for multiple scenarios or can be removed separately for cleaning. Spin scrubber are widely used in bathrooms, toilet brush, kitchens, bathtubs, wood and tile floors, glass, tires and cars. The bristles are soft and of good quality and will not scratch tiles, glass and cars. You can use it at ease

items: Please do not immerse the main body in water, to prevent the product from failing to charge due to water entering the charging port. Do not touch the rotating parts with your hands or skirts when using. When using the device, please avoid placing it near items that can easily get entangled, such as human hair. When using the telescopic rod, it must be twisted to retract. It cannot be retracted directly. Children should be taken care of to ensure that they do not play with the product
